program.name: Arm Volume
program.subject: Arms
program.blurb: Three arm days: a biceps day, a triceps day, then arm supersets.
program.about: Arms that fill a sleeve. One day is all biceps in straight sets, the next all triceps, and the third pairs a curl with a triceps move in supersets. The forearms come along with the curls. Abs finish every session. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps.
